research_notes: Blocked for headline years after official, employer, professional and targeted full-time/fellowship searches: medical tenure is dated but FTE is not; earlier medical experience lacks employer intervals.

Concurrent clinical, fellowship, academic and editorial roles must not be added as separate full-time years. Clinical end August 2022 overlaps elected service and is retained as published, not truncated to election day.
University and journal affiliations do not establish employer control or salaried appointment. Obtain contracts/CV with hours and leave for calculation.
